༄༅/ /kha rag bde chen thar pa gling gi gnas bstod dad ldan snying la dga' ster ku mu da'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// kha rag bde chen thar pa gling gi gnas bstod dad ldan snying la dga' ster ku mu da'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo/ bde gshegs kun gyi sku gsung thugs gsang ba// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo kun 'dus pa// padma 'byung gnas thod phreng yab yum la// snying gi padmo 'dzum pas gus phyag 'tshal// bdag cag sngon las smon lam dbang gi mthus// sangs rgyas bstan dang gtan du mjal nas kyang*// gsang sngags zab mo'i chos dag gus pas bsten// khyad par zab don nying khu rnying ma'i chos// mos pas nyams blangs drod tshad mtha' ru phyin| |de sogs mang mod khyad par mdo 'gag don// kha rag bde chen thar pa'i gling bsngags pa// dad ldan snying la dga' ster ku mu da'i// phreng ba zhes su grags pa bshad kyis nyon// de yang gnas 'di'i sgo bzhi gang nas 'ong yang rung ste/ mjal rgyu'i ngo bo zangs mdog dpal gyi ri 'di/ gtso bo bstan pa'i bdag po shākya'i rgyal po la brag dang ri gzhan rnams ni 'khor dgra bcom byang sems nyan thos dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la/ mdun ri g.yu'i maṇḍal bkod pa 'dra ba dang*/ mchod pa'i lha mo mang pos mchod rdzas du mas mchod pa'i tshul du yod/ las bzhi dang sbyar na/ ri phal cher dbyibs zlum por yod cing brag dkar mang bas zhi ba'i gnas dang*/ la la kha dog ser zhing dbyibs ni gru bzhir ldan pas rgyas pa'i gnas/ rdza ri kha dog dmar la phug pa mang po zla gam du yod pas na dbang gi gnas/ brag ri la la sngo nag mtshon cha gzings pa 'dra zhing*/ chu bo rnams drag sngags kyi sgra sgrog cing rngam stabs su 'bab pa ni drag po'i gnas sogs kyi mtshan nyid yin la/ las bzhi gang gi sgo nas mchog thun gang sgrub kyang 'grub myur ba'i gnas su go/ bdag dkon mchog ming gis kyang gnas mchog de'i yon tan thos shing mjal bar mos te chas pa'i lam bar kha rag mdo zhes par/ rigs rus dang stobs kyis mngon par mtho zhing*/ byang rgyud rgyal po'i sras mo a rdil sras yum gyis gzhi len zhag tshugs kyi nub/

gu shrī chen po'i gdung karma bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal/ nged zhang dbon mnyam du nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ gu ru rin po che drang srong dri med kyi cha byad byas nas/ dgyes pa'i zhal bstan cing bdag la 'di skad gsung*/ o rgyan bdag gi rjes su 'jug cing skal ldan snod dang ldan pas/ kha rag bde chen thar pa'i gling du 'ong ba ni cis kyang legs/ da 'di nas rim gyis song dang shar ri'i rtser tshe chu phug bya ba'i 'og tu snga gong sus kyang ma mthong ba'i phug pa sgo thal mo sbyar ba 'dra ba zhigayod pas/ der song dang pad 'byung bdag gis 'gro ba rnams tshe'i bar chad las skyob pa'i phyir tshe'i sgrub pa bgyis pa'i gnas yin te/ de'i nang phyi khyams gcig la nang du phug pa mang ba zhig yod kyang re zhig thams cad phye ba'i dus la cung zhig ma bab 'dug pas zhog la/ yar phyin pa'i g.yas ldebs kyi brag la gter khung hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yod/ phug pa'i dkyil rang du tshe bdag gshin rje 'bur du dod pa dang*/ gzhan yang lha dang yig sna shin tu mang ba yod/ de'i phug tu pad 'byung bdag gi sgrub gnas tshe gzhong bdud rtsis mer ba dang*/ mgon po tshe dpag med 'bur du dod pa yod do zhes pa'i gnang ba thob/ nam langs pa dang rim gyis lung thob pa ltar phyin pa las/ tshe chu phug tu 'byor zhing*/ phug pa 'og ma'i sgo yang rnyed/ snang gsal dang bcas phar phyin pas/ gu ru'i gsung bzhin tshogs khang gi g.yas ldebs la gter khung dang gter yig shin tu mang ba zhig mjal/ dkyil du brag 'bur zhig 'dug par tshe bdag gshin rje'i sku 'bur dod yod gsungs pa 'di yin par 'dug byas thams cad la bstan pas der mtheb rjes zhig byung*/ de'i 'og tu brag kyong zhig 'dug pas tshe gzhong bdud rtsis gang ba yod gsungs pa de 'dir yod dam snyam lag g.yon 'og tu bzhag /g.yas kyis de'i nang du nyul bas rkang pa 'dred pa'i rkyen byas lag gnyis rtse 'phrod pa'i sna lung chen po zhig kyang byung*/

gter yig dang rang byung gi yig sna shin tu mang ba mjal/ de nas gzims phug gi sgo brag g.yam gyis bcad 'dug pa bsal nas phyin pas/ o rgyan rin po che'i gzims mal gyi g.yon phyogs su/ mgon po tshe dpag med 'bur sku'i mdun du/ tshe gzhong bdud rtsis gang ba spyad pas mi 'dzad pa rnyed de/ thams cad kyang nyams 'ur zhing rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba phyin ci ma log pa mngon du gyur pas na/ phug pa'i ming yang khyung chen phug tu grags la/ der lo bdun bsdad nas las 'phro can gyis bsgrub na tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes shing lus ma spangs par dpal ri padma 'od du 'gro/ zla bar bsgrub na nad gdon bar chad kyis mi tshugs shing mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob/ zhag bdun bsgrub na yang tshe mthar phyin cing rig 'dzin gyi gral la 'khod par gdon mi za'o// de nub 'od gsal phug tu bsdad/ phyi nangs rim gyis song ba las/ thub pa gnas brtan bcu drug bzhugs pa'i phug par klu'i rgyal po dung skyong la klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba mthong*/ zil gnon phug bya bar rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu la rta pa brgyad/ gnod sbyin stag mda' gdong sogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ mgon po bram gzugs/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can sogs shin tu gsal ba dang*/ o rgyan rin po che'i phyag rjes sngar ma grags pa zhig kyang rnyed/ de nas tshogs 'khor sgang du tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing*/ dad ldan pho mo ban skye mang du 'dus pa la/ ma hā gu ru'i sgom bzlas kyi rjes gnang sogs bgyis shing*/ slar mkha' 'gro'i gsang phug nas brgyud de phyin pa na/ dbugs ngal gso zhing bltas pa'i phar ldebs kyi brag logs ngos/ 'od zer pa tra 'dra ba'i nang du rje btsun spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gso shin tu che ba zhig mjal/ yang gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs rjes khri phrag yod pa'i 'og phyogs kyi brag la/

'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa zhig 'dug par 'di ni dpa' bo gcig pa red byas pa'i zhar la mdzub mo gsum gyi rjes kyang yod/ mgon khang phug gi g.yas phyogs kyi brag dmar gyi g.yas ldebs la/ o rgyan yab yum dang rig 'dzin du ma'i zhabs rjes dang phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i rjes/ gnyan chen thang lha'i sku mi dkar rta dkar can sogs gsal ba dang*/ mgon khang de'i phyi nang thams cad du phyag mtshan gyi bye brag bya gcan gzan stag dom dred dang 'phan gdugs kyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'dug kyang*/ dbye gsal yi ger 'jigs nas bzhag /lam bar zhig tu o rgyan rin po ches dad rten stsal ba'i gnas rdo tshon gang pa zhig la gu ru'i sku yongs su dod pa zhig rnyed pa dad pa'i rten du go ste khyer/ padma shel phug tu slebs 'phral grub chen ma zhig 'dug pas spos dkar nag gi dud pa btang byung ba sku de la bdugs shing*/ der yod pa thams cad la ston par brtsam ma thag /nam mkha' nas gzugs mi mngon pa'i skad kyis 'di skad do// kye/ khyung chen phug gi dran snang dang*// dag snang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dang*| |mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku brnyan rnams// lo gsum bar du akthaṃ rgya// zhes sogs brjod par mi 'os pa'i tshig 'ga' dang bcas/ dus la bab pa na zhar gyis ston zhig pa'i lung bstan yang gsal la mang ba zhig byung*/ gzhan yang gnas mchog der sku dang phyag mtshan/ nor gter/ chos gter/ phug pa sogs mang ba zhig 'dug kyang*/ la la ni dus la ma bab/ la la ni gter srung gis 'khu bar 'dug /kha cig ni rten 'brel phra mos kyang bkag pas re zhig gab pa ltar yin/ khyung chen phug gi gter khung hūm̐ gis rgyas btab pa de ni nga rang stod lung du rig 'dzin bdud 'dul grags pa zhes rta lo pa zhig tu skyes nas 'don pa'i lung bstan dang*/ gter chos kyang tshe'i skor sogs po ti tshad ldan bdun dang*/

ma hā gu rus bsgrubs pa'i tshe'i ril bu 'gro ba gang gis myong yang tshe'i bar chad las rgyal zhing*/ skye ba mi bgrang bar mngon par 'tshang rgya ba sogs lung bstan mang ba zhig byung yang*/ stobs zhan la rnam rtog rags pa/ blo chung zhing yid ches pa dkon par 'dug pas re zhig las gsal bar ma bris/ thung tsam 'di kha rag tu bris pa de las cung zhig gsal bar byas te/ sdings nas a bo dpal 'byor gyis nan gyis bskul ba las/ shākya'i btsun pa chos smra ba dkon mchog phun tshogs rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ rang lo bco brgyad steng*/ chu mo byi ba'i lo hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu drug la/ sgar chen blo mos rgyal du bzhugs thog bris pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
